data.description:
## Observation

Closing abstracted-busy-copperhead (2d87-7428-abcf-4bd9) on 2026-10-28:

1. The completion verifier refused the close with one unmet criterion (a Gerrit/CI fact), and its remediation text says: for evidence outside the repository, "mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment".
2. I added `[non-codebase] ` to that one criterion line and recorded the evidence comment.
3. The retried close was refused by the plan-review close gate: "stale-material: the plan was materially edited since review — changed: description (2045 -> 2060 chars); its TEXT changed ... ticking an AC checkbox is attestation-SAFE".

So following the verifier's own remediation invalidates the plan-review attestation, and the close then needs a fresh `review-plan` (15–20 minutes plus a billable LLM pass) for a tag that changes no plan content.

## Expected

The `[non-codebase]` tag the verifier asks for is normalized out of plan-material the same way checkbox state already is, so adding it does not make the plan-review attestation stale. Or the verifier's remediation names a route that does not edit the reviewed text.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Adding or removing `[non-codebase]` on an acceptance-criterion line leaves the plan-review attestation current.
- [ ] Any other text change on that line still makes the attestation stale.
- [ ] A test covers both cases.
data.title: Following the completion verifier's [non-codebase] remediation makes the plan-review attestation stale
